site_name: Cologix ASH1 (Scalelogix), 21745 Beaumeade Circle, Ashburn, VA 20147
year_evidence_quote: This state-of-the-art facility has been pre-leased by a major global technology company and went into service in May 2023.
year_site_match: The release names "the three-story, 455,000-square-foot Scalelogix ASH1 data center located in Ashburn, Virginia". Cologix's own ASH1 page gives ASH1's address as "21745 Beaumeade Circle, Ashburn, Virginia" and describes the same building ("455K SQFT, three-story, Cologix-owned Scalelogix data center").
verification: Cologix press release dated June 15, 2023 states outright that ASH1 went into service in May 2023 and that the facility was finished "in seven months from permit to customer turnover". The release has no street address; the address tie comes from Cologix's ASH1 page, which matches on name, size, and stories. The DCD article returned HTTP 403 and was not read. The 120 MW figure appears on the ASH1 page as "Site capacity: 120 MW" (operator's self-reported figure). Quotes were extracted through a page-reading tool; I did not see raw HTML.

site_name: CoreSite VA3, 12369 Sunrise Valley Drive, Reston, VA 20191 (Sunrise Technology Park)
year_evidence_quote: CoreSite Realty has opened its new data center campus in Reston, Virginia,
year_site_match: Article (titled "CoreSite Opens New Campus in Northern Virginia") places the new campus on "the Sunrise Technology Park" in Reston, distinguishes it from VA1 and VA2 "just down the block", and its photo caption reads "An aerial view of the CoreSite VA3 data center campus in Reston, Virginia." CoreSite's own pages give VA3's address as "12369 Sunrise Valley Drive, Reston, VA 20191" (VA1 is 12100 and VA2 is 12098 Sunrise Valley Drive).
verification: Data Center Frontier, Oct. 15, 2019 (Rich Miller), says CoreSite "has officially opened" the new Reston campus. VA3 is named only in the photo caption, not the body; the address tie is from CoreSite's location and VA3 pages. Caveat: the article describes an official campus opening and does not say which building at the park went live first or on what date; I am uncertain whether an initial phase entered service earlier in 2019 or before (not verified on any page I opened). CoreSite's VA3 page gives no opening year. The cited URL slug reads "voices-of-the-industry" but the page content is the CoreSite opening article.

lead.year_evidence_quote: CoreSite Realty has opened its new data center campus in Reston, Virginia
lead.notes: Data Center Frontier reported on Oct 15, 2019 that CoreSite opened its new campus in Reston on the Sunrise Technology Park. Its photo caption names the campus VA3. CoreSite's own location page gives VA3's address as 12369 Sunrise Valley Drive, and the permit holder (CoreSite Real Estate Sunrise Technology Park, LLC) matches. The article says CoreSite repurposed existing buildings on the park, so I could not confirm that 12369 was the first VA3 building to go live. VA1 and VA2 are separate CoreSite buildings on other Sunrise Valley addresses and are not this site.

site_name: Sabey Intergate.Ashburn, 21741 Red Rum Drive, Ashburn, VA 20147 (first building: Building C)
year_evidence_quote: has completed and tested its first Northern Virginia data center.
year_site_match: Article says "The facility is the first of three the company is planning to build at its Intergate.Ashburn campus" and the caption reads "Building C on Sabey's Intergate.Asbhurn data center campus in Ashburn, Virginia". Sabey's own Ashburn page lists the campus address as "21741 Red Rum Dr", "Ashburn, VA 20147" and describes a three-building campus (A, B, C).
verification: Data Center Knowledge, Feb. 23, 2017, reports the first building at Intergate.Ashburn completed and tested, with a tenant already signed for a 1.8MW quadrant in "the newly finished building, whose total capacity is 7.2MW". The article has no street address; the address tie is Sabey's own Ashburn location page (campus-level, 21741 Red Rum Dr), which is not a directory. Neither page states that 21741 Red Rum Dr is Building C specifically, only that it is the campus address. The Performance Contracting page shows "Sabey Corporation | Ashburn, VA | May 2017" and "Phase 1 of 3 buildings"; the May 2017 date is unlabeled, so I did not rely on it, but it is consistent with 2017. The article says completed and tested, not that the tenant had moved in; under the stated rule a dated article reporting completion counts for the page-date year.

lead.year_evidence_quote: has completed and tested its first Northern Virginia data center
lead.notes: Data Center Knowledge reported on Feb 23, 2017 that Sabey had completed and tested its first Northern Virginia data center (Building C, per the photo caption), with 7.2 MW and a tenant already signed. The permit names Intergate-Ashburn LLC, which ties it to this campus. Only a directory ties 21741 Red Rum Dr to Building C specifically. The 2017 date is for the campus's first building. I did not date Building B or Building A.

site_name: Serverfarm TiTAN data center (former Ask.com / RS Titan), 4949 Randolph Rd NE, Moses Lake, WA 98837

lead.notes: The earlier 2011 lead is likely too late. Ecology Order 15AQ-E616 (2015) says the Titan Data Center shares its building with RS Manager Data Center (fka ASK.com). The Columbia Basin Herald (May 25, 2011) says the first permit was approved in 2007 for tenant Ask.com's generators. Ask.com confirmed the TITAN site in July 2007, and a search snippet (not opened) suggests it opened in December, probably 2007. I could not confirm the year, so it is left null. Separately, Data Center Knowledge (April 2011) reported Server Farm Realty space at TiTAN 'now available', which is a Titan-wing milestone and not the first use of the building.
